thread:
maria (Support): FYI — Customer is refusing to accept the final invoice. Procurement says they require an internal 'requisition code' on the invoice, not just a PO. They sent a reference "REQ-2024-889" but procurement insists it must be in their format 'RQ-<4digits>-<country>' and include cost center. Screenshot/link attached: https://files.redwood/example-req-snap.png :eyes:
kevin - AR: do we have the invoice PDF we plan to send? can we add a separate field for 'Customer Requisition' in the metadata?
jessica (AE): we have SOW and MSA signed. Customer told me their procurement team is rigid — they won't release payment without the requisition code stamped on invoice. I've asked them for the exact string but they may only provide via procurement portal. I can nudge them.
omar (Billing): our billing system requires a PO number or it rejects for automated ingestion. We can add freeform fields to the PDF body, but the AP system of some customers will only parse the 'PO' field. If it's truly a 'requisition code' it's usually okay if we put it in the invoice header and also in the PDF text.
maria (Support): example of what they want (they pasted):
```
Requested Requisition: RQ-7789-CA
Cost Center: ENG-OPS-42
Customer Contact: procurement@acmehealth.example
```
kevin - AR: could we instead send a proforma (non-final) tagged with that requisition while Sales gets an official PO? that'll buy time if they need the specific format for their ERPs.
jessica (AE): yeah I'll ask them to generate a formal PO with that requisition code. but procurement says their portal only issues a PO once their internal requisition record is attached, and that might take 2 business days.
luca (Legal): quick note — as long as the SOW/MSA cover services and rates, adding the requisition code to the invoice shouldn't change contract terms. we don't need a new signature.
omar (Billing): ok — plan B: prepare two invoice artifacts: (1) proforma with "Requested Requisition" in the header and metadata, (2) final invoice template ready to inject PO number and requisition once we get the PO. I'll prepare a PDF template.
procurement-bot: Invoice template v3 supports a custom metadata field "customer_requisition" which maps to the top-right header. Use code: `customer_requisition` -> visible on PDF and optional in metadata.
maria (Support): omar, can you paste a minimal metadata snippet you plan to use so Sales knows exactly what to ask for?
omar (Billing): here's the snippet we'll insert in the invoice system (will appear on PDF header):
```
{
  "po_number": "",
  "customer_requisition": "RQ-7789-CA",
  "cost_center": "ENG-OPS-42"
}
```
kevin - AR: perfect. once we have that, AR will mark the invoice for manual routing to accounts-payable. Also please include net-30 terms in the proforma so procurement knows payment terms.
jessica (AE): I'll request the formal PO and ask they include the exact "customer_requisition" and cost center. pinging @sales-oncall to let them know this will likely need procurement follow-up. :+1:
sales-oncall: on it — I'll open a ticket with AcmeHealth procurement and request the PO export (will escalate to vendor admin if portal is blocking). ETA 24–48h.
maria (Support): thanks everyone. documenting next steps: 1) Sales requests formal PO with requisition and cost center (jessica/sales-oncall) 2) Billing prepares proforma tagged with requested requisition (omar) 3) AR holds final invoice until PO arrives (kevin) 4) Support to monitor thread and update customer status (maria)
kevin - AR: leaving a note for collections — hold until we have either (a) PO matching the requisition, or (b) customer confirms they will accept invoice with "Customer Requisition" field only.
luca (Legal): approved to proceed with proforma. no contract changes needed.
maria (Support): closing loop — customer responded: "We can provide the official PO by EOD Thursday if Redwood can send a proforma showing 'Requested Requisition' RQ-7789-CA." sales-oncall, can you confirm timeline?
sales-oncall: confirmed. pushing for EOD Thursday. will update here once PO is uploaded.
maria (Support): great — keeping this thread pinned for billing/AR. :white_check_mark:
